newsitem.title: USA: Small chance seen for rain in dry HRW wheat areas.
newsitem.headline: Small chance seen for rain in dry HRW wheat areas.

text.p: Dry hard red winter wheat areas of western Kansas should be missed by next week's storm systems, which meteorologists said may bring rain to eastern Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas.
"I can't get any rain in there. It doesn't look favorable," said Fred Gesser, Weather Express Inc meteorologist, referring to dry Nebraska and western Kansas wheat areas.
Joel Burgio, Weather Services Corp meteorologist, said the best chance for rain for western Kansas wheat was Monday to Wednesday, but "even then it doesn't look like a really good chance."
Dodge City in southwest Kansas has had no rain this month, and WSC's data indicates it has received 31 percent of its normal rainfall the past 30 days.
Warm weather should spread through the area next week, and Gesser said highs should be in the 80s and 90s degrees Fahrenheit from Kansas to Texas.
